question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is** "Coutious."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"cautious."** • The incorrect spelling has** "o" instead of "a." ** • The correct pronunciation is **"kaw-shuhs".** • **"Cautious" **means being careful or wary of potential danger or problems. (सावधान, सतर्क, चौकस) • **Example**: *I am very **cautious**__ about expressing my opinions.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "Irrational"**, means not logical or reasonable. (जो तर्क या स्‍पष्‍ट चिंतन पर आधारित न हो; तर्कहीन, विवेकहीन, अतार्किक) • **Option 3, "Intelligent"**, means having the ability to learn, understand, or think critically. 9समझने, सीखने और सोचने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न, बुद्धिमान; चतुर) • **Option 4, "Excessive"**, means going beyond what is necessary or normal. (अत्‍यधिक; बहुत अधिक) 18b:Te6c, The correct answer is **"assist."**
